pages.text: $(bold)Core Modifier Block$()$(br2)A special workbench for upgrading and customizing ship cores.$(br2)$(bold)Features:$()$(br)• Upgrade core tier (Small → Medium → Large)$(br)• Install enhancement modules$(br)• Modify core attributes$(br)• Unlock advanced capabilities

$(bold)Usage:$()$(br)1. Craft and place a Core Modifier block$(br)2. Right-click to open the interface$(br)3. Insert your ship core$(br)4. Select upgrade options$(br)5. Provide required materials$(br)6. Complete the modification$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Higher-tier upgrades require rare materials from dungeons and ruins!
